notes: MANUAL REGRESSION ONLY. code-review is a reserved improvement target (improvement-scope RESERVED_TARGETS), so the improvement loop can never propose a candidate for it and this suite, with its held-out case, never gates an automated candidate. Run it by hand to guard a person-made change to the skill.

The checks only READ review.md (no agent code runs). They are structural, not semantic: they parse the findings table and require, in one SERIOUS row, the defect and, in that row's action cell, a concrete fix, then a blocking final verdict (any usual wording is accepted; approving fails). A review that puts the right facts in the right cells for the wrong reasons would still pass, so calibrate a changed check against real reviews (tools/__tests__/skill-regress.test.js does, with the four 2026-07-16 reviews).

evals.name: masked-fixture-refactor
evals.prompt: Review PR #418 described in PR.md (the existing code it touches is described in repo-context.md). Write your review to review.md in the current directory: a findings table (severity, location, finding, suggested action) and a final line starting with "Verdict:" that says either "Approved" or "Changes Requested". Severities are CRITICAL, MAJOR, MINOR and NIT.
